_comment: Milestone 4 dry-run proposals. Produced by the engineer reading the real page text, in place of a live LLM (no API credentials in this environment). Includes genuine candidates AND the failure modes a real model produces - paraphrase, arithmetic, fabricated framing, invented dates, entity over-reach. Every row goes through the same V1-V8 validators.

burst.raw_quote: The most expensive sector for houses is Sector S, averaging 10.68 Crore at 29,000 per square foot, up 20% in a year.
The strongest return on the board is Sector F flats at 4.47% gross, based on a 3.68 Crore purchase renting at 1.37 Lakh a month
there is no plot file market. The society is built out. You are buying a house or a flat, not a file.

cdb_ph10.raw_quote: DHA Lahore has shared an official notice on its verified pages. In short, August 2026 will bring a series of major announcements about the phase, and balloting sits right at the top of that list.
